identity: stable metadata id; folder path is not identity
rules: Each work folder has one index.yaml node; index is the node, not an extra directory listing.
Split by independently owned questions and acceptance boundaries, not workflow stages. Names and depth stay flexible.

Canonical index.yaml uses work/node@2 metadata. New Business has a readable businessOverview and nested SRS leaves with extensions.work3.specification payload (schema: starci/specification@2). Legacy compact business remains readable; it is not a second detailed copy of a new SRS.

Business/index.yaml aggregates overview/index.yaml and srs/index.yaml. SRS folders are recursive cohesive capabilities, each leaf containing its own requirements, actors, states, rules, full flows and acceptance; do not split those linked concerns into disconnected tables. Architecture separates independently owned design concerns only when useful for the actual scope.
Do not atomize by template. Create or retain a child when it owns a distinct question, decision, implementation boundary or acceptance result; otherwise keep the material together.

Only leaves author state: uninvestigate, todo or done. todo is confirmed incomplete work and requires no investigation receipt. activity is auxiliary: idle, investigating, implementing or verifying. blockers[] explains impediments without becoming lifecycle state. Parents author no state or completion and derive progress from required descendants.

When investigation occurs, investigation.contextDigest binds semantic context, excluding child rollup and auxiliary activity, blockers and history. A semantic parent change makes every affected descendant effectively uninvestigate while preserving stored done, completion, history and evidence.
dependsOn uses stable node IDs. A semantic dependency change invalidates affected dependent nodes transitively; refs bind semantic inputs without implying execution order.
Extend existing nodes and preserve stable IDs, history, assets and evidence. New required work prevents parent done; unrelated completed branches remain intact.
Declare semantic design/source files using node.assets with paths under own assets/. Their exact bytes contribute to semantic context; conservative hashing does not ignore presumed typo-only edits.

Record output screenshots/videos in evidence assets with scope: node and paths under the primary owner assets/. Output evidence is not also declared as a semantic input, avoiding self-invalidating proof.
Source code remains in bound repositories; code/index.yaml tracks requirements, exact source references and completion.

All structured Work records and results use YAML. JSON and underscore-prefixed directories are rejected in canonical records, except the workspace-root _local directory reserved for excluded execution state; central schemas stay in .claude.
Repository and environment provenance is written directly in sourceRefs or the owning module record. refs and dependsOn remain stable technical node IDs for digest propagation.
UAT accounts.yaml uses work/disposable-accounts@1 and may contain only synthetic disposable local role, username and password values. Images and video remain original binary assets.
Workflow session traces live inside .starciwork/_local/plans and never enter canonical Work hashes.
Each module UI direction belongs to ui/index.yaml. Generated drawings and design PNGs belong under ui/assets and are declared in both ui.assets and top-level assets for byte binding.
Implementation/index.yaml is a derived parent with no authored state, completion or implementation payload. Frontend and backend children separately describe actual source.
Frontend assets contain screenshots of the running page, never source design PNGs. UAT screenshots and videos stay under the owning uat/<flow>/assets directory.
